GC.heap_dump requires a filename, has high impact and normally requests full GC; Thread.print impact depends on thread count. Available commands/options must match the target.

sources.version: JEP 444 delivered in JDK 21; used for thread-dump coverage distinction, not all later runtime guarantees
sources.supports: Traditional dumps omit virtual threads; the separate mechanism has different detail and tracking constraints.

Template contains JavaExceptionThrow throttle 100/s, ObjectAllocationSample throttle 150/s, JavaMonitorEnter threshold 20 ms. These settings support the coverage caveat; they do not establish the settings of an arbitrary target recording.

Cause and suppression are distinct contracts; suppressed exceptions are often cleanup failures, but addSuppressed is also callable. Absence of a recorded cause does not establish absence of an initiating failure.

Read Committed uses statement snapshots; Repeatable Read retains the first non-transaction statement snapshot, with visibility of own writes. Current database visibility is not complete write history.
Choose design by objective, factors, resources and error control; this supports deliberate interaction comparisons rather than interpreting a successful uncontrolled batch.
